title: Triggers
description: Creating and managing DML and DDL triggers, INSTEAD OF triggers, enabling/disabling, and listing trigger definitions.
longDescription: This module covers SQL Server triggers in depth. You'll learn about DML triggers that respond to INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE events, DDL triggers that monitor schema changes, INSTEAD OF triggers for views, and how to enable, disable, rename, and drop triggers.
whatYouLearn: Understand the different types of triggers in SQL Server
Create DML triggers for INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE events
Create DDL triggers to monitor schema changes
Use INSTEAD OF triggers with views
Drop triggers and list trigger definitions
